cash_breakdown.item: Chinese Mainland cash and fixed deposits
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report says remittance out of Chinese Mainland is subject to foreign exchange control; most production entities are mainland subsidiaries, so funds are not treated as immediately parent-level cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included in cash and cash equivalents and fixed deposits situated in Chinese Mainland.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Principal is guaranteed, but return floats and product is classified at FVTPL rather than ordinary cash; 20% discount reflects product and liquidity uncertainty.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Automotive display manufacturing has HK$13.45bn revenue, HK$2.90bn trade debtors/bills receivable, HK$1.78bn inventory and large supplier payables; one conservative liquidity buffer is retained for production, payroll, warranty and collection-cycle volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: Estimated operating liquidity reserve, not a disclosed line item.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend extraction friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Additional reserve for cross-border remittance, withholding tax and currency friction not fully captured by asset haircuts.
cash_breakdown.reason: Analyst estimate tied to the mainland cash and subsidiary structure disclosure.

profit_quality.assessment: Usable but discounted. Three-year operating cash flow exceeds reported profit, but 2024 cash generation depended heavily on a HK$1.431bn increase in trade and other payables, while the business is an auto display manufacturer exposed to product mix, pricing, inventory write-downs and growth capex.
adjustments: Start from a conservative HK$350m pre-haircut distributable cash profit, below the 2022-2024 median parent net profit of HK$475m.
Exclude the economic benefit of interest income on peelable funds; 2024 interest income was HK$115m and should not support the operating-business denominator after cash is treated as detachable.
Use 0.70 profit haircut for manufacturing cyclicality, customer project timing, pricing pressure, inventory risk and working-capital volatility.
Use reported 2023 capex HK$502m as a rough maintenance/growth boundary reference; actual 2024 capex HK$568m and 2022 capex HK$1.176bn include Chengdu expansion.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was HK$774m in 2022, HK$1.186bn in 2023 and HK$1.457bn in 2024; capex was HK$1.176bn, HK$502m and HK$568m respectively.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cash conversion is good on headline three-year data, but the denominator is reduced for detachable-funds interest income, auto display price/mix pressure, inventory write-downs and the risk that high growth still needs working capital and capex.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year OCF / parent net profit is above 1, but 2024 OCF is flattered by supplier/payable financing.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; 2023 purchase of PPE HK$502m is used as a conservative reference and 2022/2024 include expansion.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables increased HK$719m in 2024, inventory decreased HK$136m, and payables increased HK$1.431bn; this is favorable cash flow but not a clean recurring cash margin.
